| ${x}_{2}$ | **$9$** | **$12$** | **$16$** | **$20$** | **$23$** |
| ${x}_{3}$ | **$1$** | **$5$** | **$7$** | **$11$** | **$14$** |
| $y$ | $5$ | $8$ | $12$ | $14$ | $18$ |

The vector of coefficients of the hyperplane $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}_{3}$ that best fits the data above can be found using multiple linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?
